proposed.text: Table VIII.1 distinguishes zone types by firewall status for PSO and area metrics. Which other two tables must an architect consult when both lot type (corner vs. inside) and Table VIII.1 give different PSO values, and what rule governs the conflict?

options.text: Table VIII.1 and the local zoning ordinance; the local ordinance always supersedes the national standard unless otherwise stated
Table VII.1 (lot-type PSO) and Table VIII.G.6 (lot-type TOSL); Rule VII Sec. 704.4.a — use the most restrictive applicable value
Table VII.1 (lot-type PSO) and Table VIII.1; the larger PSO value from either table may be selected by the owner, subject to local authority approval
Table VIII.G.6 (lot-type TOSL) and Table IX.1 (structural setbacks); Table IX.1 governs when setbacks are involved, especially in mixed-use developments

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Table VIII.1 provides firewall-based PSO, ISA, USA, MACA, TOSL. Table VII.1 provides lot-type-based PSO (inside/corner/through). Table VIII.G.6 provides lot-type-based TOSL. When these tables yield different values, Rule VII Sec. 704.4.a mandates using the most restrictive (most stringent) applicable value for each metric. Option A is incorrect — local ordinances must conform to national minimums. Option C reverses the rule — the more permissive value cannot be selected. Option D cites a non-existent Table IX.1.
proposed.explanation: Three-table procedure: (1) Get firewall-based PSO, ISA, USA, MACA from Table VIII.1. (2) Get lot-type PSO from Table VII.1. (3) Get lot-type TOSL from Table VIII.G.6. (4) Apply Rule VII Sec. 704.4.a: use the most restrictive value for each metric. Table VIII.1 does NOT distinguish inside vs. corner lots — that is the role of Table VII.1.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096, Rule VII, Sec. 704.4.a; Table VII.1; Table VIII.G.6
